scripts.build: node apps/web/tools/stamp-deploy.mjs && bun run registry && bun run site:css && bun run specimen:css && bun run --filter @mauricekleine/web build
scripts.deploy:preview: cd apps/web && cf workers versions create --prebuilt
scripts.dev: bun run --cwd packages/superthread build && bun run site:css && bun run --filter @mauricekleine/web dev
scripts.registry: bun run --cwd packages/superthread build && shadcn build packages/superthread/registry.json --output apps/web/public/r
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/superthread test && node apps/web/tools/test-worker.mjs
